notes: Migrated to the current unified Fact model (role-less on-disk source/sink arrays, to/from, annotations required, no id). Facts: self-cast (Hand, typeLine-anchored), self-enters (Battlefield, typeLine-anchored), a real `tap` produce (targeted:true, target:{types:{hasAny:['Artifact','Creature']}}) for the ETB tap trigger, a matching Battlefield-presence sink (same hasAny type set, no controller restriction — oracle prints no controller restriction on the enchant target), and (2026-09-12, ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #18's closure) a real `grantKeyword` produce (`keyword:'CantActivateAbilities'`, `target:{equippedBySelf:true}`, `value:-1` — a genuine lockdown, not a boon) for the 'its activated abilities can't be activated' clause, now real, executable machinery (`CardDefinition.activatedAbilityLock`, checked by `engine.ts`'s `canActivateAbility` via `state.ts`'s new `isActivationLocked`) instead of inert text. No Fact for 'doesn't untap' (still a real, unenforced static lock — state.ts's untap() only special-cases the STUN-counter replacement, same gap sleep-magic's identical clause has) or for Flash (timing-only, no board-state fact). Migrated scenarios.ts to a real engine-piloted trace (`runEngineScenarios`, dropping the old flat `harness.ts` Scenario[]/`keywordScenarios` spread, which contributed nothing anyway) — casts this Aura (Flash) onto a real Coeurl (a real FIN creature with its own real `{1}{W}, {T}` activated ability), demonstrating via `engine-trace.ts`'s new-to-this-pool `pilotExpectIllegalActivate` that Coeurl's own ability is genuinely rejected by `canActivateAbility` once locked — real trace evidence (`fn:'illegalAttempt'` with the actual CantBeActivated reason), not just a unit test. Two more real bugs fixed in the process, both required for the lock to ever have anything live to attach to: (1) the onEnter trigger's own effect used to be a bare declarative `tapTarget` with no `actions.equip` call at all — this Aura never actually became attached (`RealCard.attachedToId` stayed unset forever), which would have made `equippedBySelf`-based grants permanently inert regardless of this pass; fixed to a real `custom` effect performing both the attach and the tap (mirrors sleep-magic's own onEnter shape). (2) the trigger was also missing `on:'enter'` (present on sleep-magic's own identical trigger but absent here) — without it, `engine.ts`'s real ETB auto-fire never picks this trigger up at all when cast through the real engine path. `scripts/verify-synergy.mjs`'s `IGNORED_FNS` gained `illegalAttempt` (this is the first real pool card to use the `pilotExpectIllegal*` family) — purely observational by that family's own doc comment, so it's classified with `cast`/`trigger`/`phase`/etc., not `PARKED_ACTION_FNS`.
knownGaps: 'Enchanted permanent doesn't untap during its controller's untap step' — state.ts's untap() only special-cases the real STUN counter replacement; no general per-object 'can't untap' lock exists. Unenforced, same gap sleep-magic's identical clause already has. NOT touched by ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #18's closure (2026-09-12) — that closed only the separate 'activated abilities can't be activated' half of this same sentence.
